about.text: A particularly rich sweet cream of 40 to 55 % fat, firm enough to spoon and to cook with without splitting, used to finish soups, sauces and desserts.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The cream is standardised to a very high fat, so it is thick enough to spoon and survives cooking without splitting. Heat treatment and any thickening are not described in the source opened.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.
